scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ai-chat/shared build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @ai-chat/api dev" "pnpm --filter @ai-chat/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-chat/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-chat/web build && pnpm --filter @ai-chat/api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-chat/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @ai-chat/api exec tsx ../../e2e/fixture_server.ts" "pnpm --filter @ai-chat/web exec vite --mode e2e --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173"
